description: Cancel a subscription. Destructive. Manual records are marked cancelled. Provider-backed records are cancelled with the payment provider — Stripe is scheduled to stop at the period end and QFPay is cancelled at the gateway — so auto-renew turns off and paid access continues until the period ends. If the provider is unreachable or unsupported the call fails and the subscription is left unchanged.
name: cancel_subscription
